{{DISPLAYTITLE:Marvel Rivals Ignite: 2026}} {{Marvel Rivals Ignite Navbox/2026}} {{IgniteTabs}} {{Infobox series |name=Marvel Rivals Ignite: 2026 |image=Marvel Rivals Ignite full allmode.png |organizer=NetEase |country=Global |web=https://www.marvelrivals.com/ |twitter=MarvelRivals |facebook=marvelrivals |instagram=marvelrivals |youtube=@MarvelRivals |discord=marvelrivals |twitch=marvelrivals |rulebook= |prev=MR Ignite/2025{{!}}Ignite: 2025 }} '''Marvel Rivals Ignite: 2026''' is the second official tournament circuit of Marvel Rivals organized by [[NetEase]] & Marvel Games, and marks the official start of the '''Marvel Rivals Professional League'''. The 2026 season introduces a Partner Teams Program, a unified Pacific region, a Preseason stage, and a Promotion & Relegation system. The circuit will feature a total prize pool exceeding $3,000,000 USD.[https://www.marvelrivalsesports.com/20251229/42828_1279132.html Marvel Rivals Esports 2026: The Professional Era Begins] =Format= =='''League Structure'''== The 2026 season is divided into three domestic stages and two international LAN events. * '''Regions:''' ** [[File:MRIG Americas allmode.png|x24px|link=]] '''Americas''' ** [[File:MRIG EMEA allmode.png|x24px|link=]] '''EMEA''' ** [[File:MRIG China allmode.png|x24px|link=]] '''China''' ** [[File:MRIG Pacific allmode.png|x24px|link=]] '''Pacific''' - ''Asia + Oceania'' *** During Group Stages, Asia and Oceania compete independently. *** During Playoffs, the sub-regions merge for cross-regional competition. =Partner Teams= The Partner Team Program was established ahead of the 2026 season with 12 teams across the Pacific, EMEA, and Americas regions. {{cite web|url=https://www.marvelrivalsesports.com/20251230/42828_1279492.html|title=Marvel Rivals Ignite Team Partners Program Opens Global Applications|date=2025-12-30}} Partner Teams will receive revenue sharing from in-game cosmetic bundles during the season and protection from relegation. * See [[Marvel_Rivals_Ignite/Partner_Teams|Partner Teams]] for details. ==[[File:Marvel Rivals Championship logo allmode.png|x34px|link=]] [[Marvel_Rivals_Championship|Marvel Rivals Championship]]== MRC serves as the path-to-pro circuit. *Teams earn points towards annual standings. Top MRC teams at the Mid Season and at end of the 2026 season play against the bottom League teams for promotion (Partner Teams receive limited protection from relegation). {| class="table2__table" ! width="140px" style="text-align:center;" | Season ! width="100px" style="text-align:center;" | Date !
